_about: The village record (Ending, scripts/ending/ending.gd; README.md, Ending): what the ending looks at and how it grades it. DESIGN lists the ending as not studied, so every rule here is ours. It plays once, on the first morning of year 3 (triggers_house.json), and the game goes on afterwards; every other New Year's morning (year 2 and from year 4) Tome brings a shorter yearly page graded the same way (data/events/year_record.json). Each page shows the first day's numbers beside today's and the gain since the last page (Game.year_pages). categories: in the order shown, each {id, name, measure, steps, unit?}: measure is one of the numbers Game.ending_values() works out (shipped_value: G of everything ever shipped at today's prices; crop_kinds: crops shipped at least once; animal_care: animals at half happiness or more; heart_bands: the villagers' heart bands added up (fourteen villagers with hearts since Nana got them, 84 at most; 12 / 25 / 40 / 63 of 78 with thirteen, 11 / 23 / 37 / 58 of 72 with twelve, 10 / 21 / 34 / 53 of 66 with eleven, 9 / 19 / 31 / 48 of 60 with ten, 8 / 17 / 28 / 43 of 54 with nine; the steps were 4 / 8 / 14 / 20 of 24 with four, 5 / 11 / 19 / 28 of 36 with six, 6 / 13 / 22 / 33 of 42 with seven, 7 / 15 / 25 / 38 of 48 with eight, now about the same share of 54); neighbours_known: villagers without hearts (the outer parts' people but Fumi, Ichiro, Genzo, Haru, Shige and Nana, and Dr. Yae: Kiku and Dr. Yae, 2) whose hidden affection is at neighbour_band or above (band 1 = 20 points: about twenty days of talk, or ten of talk and a liked gift); mine_deepest; fish_kinds: kinds ever caught; house_built: extensions finished; tool_levels: levels above 1 over the five field tools; contest_wins; recipes_known); a star for every step reached. ranks: by stars in all, each {min, title}, the highest min reached wins. field: rows under the categories, no stars, the field then and now, each {id, name, measure, unit?}: measure is one of Game.field_counts() (debris: weeds, rocks, branches and stumps on the farm; tilled: tilled cells; money: G in hand), kept on the first day of a new game. neighbour_band: see neighbours_known. friend_band: the villager with the most points is the closing speaker if their band is at least this (else Tome, as the village elder). Steps are set so a casual two years lands around Village Farmer (18-26 stars of 41), the steady plan of tools/balance.py (most crops, a full coop and barn, every extension, daily talks) around Keeper of the Satoyama (27-35; tools/play_year.gd --years=2 got 31), and the top rank needs nearly everything. The rank steps moved up when Neighbours came in (was 8 / 16 / 24 / 33 of 39). Neighbours' steps were 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 of 8 before Fumi and Ichiro got hearts, 2 / 3 / 5 / 6 of 6 before Genzo did, 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 of 5 before Haru did, 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 of 4 before Shige did, 1 / 2 / 3 of 3 before Nana did (two people leave room for two steps only, so the record has 41 stars now, not 42; the rank steps stay). Crops: 11 kinds; spring's three earn a star, summer's make 6-7, the last two stars need most of fall's four and rice. Recipes: 19, 4 known from the start (no star), the seven lessons, the radio and the five bin cards (two crops, three wild things) bring the rest; all 19 for the last star (steps were 6 / 8 / 10 / 13 of 13 before the wild recipes). Mine: every trip starts at floor 1 and a floor costs about 20 stamina to find its hole, so 20 floors is a whole day's trip with food along; the year playtest (tools/play_year.gd), mining every winter day without food, got to floor 6. Married (marriage.json) the record gets one line under the title: `spouse` says it, with the spouse's name and the day the wedding was set for (the short date, e.g. Spring 14; the flag wedding_day stays after the wedding for this). Saves that married before it was kept get the undated line. Unmarried saves show nothing. Once the child is born the line goes on with their name (child_line / child_undated, Ending.child_part): the record names them; the yearly page says how far they have grown (stages, by the child's stage that morning).
